name: p1.4_full_fit_dev_predicate_arbitration_gate
hypothesis: same-pair predicate arbitration is the dominant recoverable error after pair support is frozen

carrier.support: Top-50 physical pairs from the frozen dense carrier
carrier.single_mpo: class-compatible mask IoU > 0.5, one-to-one GT mapping

controls.L0: fit predicate bias added to predicate logits
controls.L2: fit logit adjustment from predicate prevalence
controls.L4: fit lightweight calibration model over logits and scalar evidence only
controls.selection: fit only; one locked evaluation on clean dev

gate.primary_headroom: C-A fixed-pair Top-3 predicate oracle mR@50

resource_policy.raw_shards: external registered cache and deleted after compaction
resource_policy.compact_carrier: external registered cache with SHA256 recorded in run record
